verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services provider with a case-preparation platform. Event-triggered automation rules are a plausible feature for such a platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows user-definable rules, triggers or automated actions: the platform mentions cover only document upload and readiness tracking, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
